data.title: Separate hook limits for the main thread and subagents
Add --main-max to the hook
data.description: The shared rules draw two lines: a subagent hands off past 40% of its context, and the integrator stops delegating at 25%. The hook has one `--max`. A subagent's PostToolUse payload carries `agent_id` and the main thread's doesn't, so add `--main-max <percent>` for payloads without an `agent_id`, falling back to `--max`. Red first, in `hook/hook_test.go` and `cmd/contextfill/run_test.go`. Afterwards Ben changes `~/.claude/settings.json` to `contextfill hook --max 40 --main-max 25` (the sandbox can't write it).

criteria.label: A payload without agent_id is judged against --main-max when given, else --max.
A payload with agent_id is always judged against --max.

data.title: Investigate OpenCode's session storage
data.description: Answer the four questions in project/2026-10-24-opencode-support.md from real files, not memory: where a session's messages and token counts live, how a shell inside OpenCode names its session, how it names the model and its window, and whether it has subagents and hooks. OpenCode's data is under ~/.local/share/opencode and ~/.config/opencode, which the sandbox blocks; Ben approved reading those paths with the sandbox off, and driving a live session through tmux. Nothing lifted from those files is committed.

criteria.label: A dated findings doc under project/ answers all four questions, citing field names from real files.
The doc names the session-identification fallback and what it costs, if there is no session variable.

data.title: Put a reader interface over the transcript package
data.description: One small interface: find a session, read its latest usage, list its agents. `transcript` stays Claude Code's reader and implements it. No change in behavior.

criteria.label: cmd/contextfill depends on the interface, not on transcript directly.

data.title: Add the opencode reader package
data.description: An `opencode` package beside `transcript`, implementing the interface from the findings doc. Fixtures are synthetic and built in the test.

criteria.label: Every storage shape in the findings doc has a synthetic fixture case.
A missing field is an error, never a guess.

data.title: Pick the harness in the CLI
data.description: cmd/contextfill picks the reader from the environment (CLAUDECODE=1, or OpenCode's own marker from the findings doc) and takes a `--harness` override.

criteria.label: The reader is chosen from the environment, and --harness overrides it.
README and contextfill --help cover OpenCode and --harness.

A payload with agent_id is always judged against --max.

data.note: Added hook.Limits{Max, MainMax} and `--main-max`. A payload without agent_id is judged against MainMax when it's set, otherwise against Max. `--main-max` outside `contextfill hook` is a usage error, because a bare read always reads the main thread. README and --help are updated, and the binary is installed. Ben still needs to change ~/.claude/settings.json to `contextfill hook --max 40 --main-max 25`, since the sandbox can't write that file.
